issues.trigger: Persistence fails after an analysis parent or output has been written.
issues.resolution: A JWT-owned SECURITY INVOKER RPC persists all rows in one transaction and accepts identical retries.

issues.trigger: A cited chunk ID is incorrectly queried as a document external ID.
issues.resolution: Resolve chunk and document IDs inside the transaction; unresolved citations roll back rather than silently disappearing.

issues.trigger: A model argument has missing or invented citation IDs.
issues.resolution: Withhold the ungrounded assertion and its synthesis; never attach unrelated fallback sources. Source membership alone is not an entailment guarantee.

issues.trigger: A response for an old claim arrives after another claim or account was opened.
issues.resolution: Claim-context generations and a synchronous submission lock discard stale answers, errors and completion state.

issues.trigger: Rapid watchlist changes return full-list snapshots out of order.
issues.resolution: Serialize changes per account using the settled list; discard abandoned account requests.

issues.trigger: Pure-function checks miss failures between screen transitions, the HTTP client and backend services.
issues.resolution: Run mounted React screens against an isolated review API through both rounds, explanation and saved-history reopening.

issues.trigger: A platform returns no accessibility subscription object during cleanup.
issues.resolution: Make subscription disposal optional while retaining the platform no-animation fallback.

issues.trigger: History requires one HTTP read per saved result and claim lookup scans all history.
issues.resolution: Fetch bounded history pages in two queries, index claim lookup and merge overlapping frontend pages by ID.

issues.trigger: Opening a saved analysis and then another security reuses old evidence or returns to the wrong stock detail.
issues.resolution: Research visits clear prior analysis context, evidence uses the current stock bundle, and saved results load their own research context. Abandoned history requests cannot overwrite newer navigation errors.

issues.trigger: Weekly history exceeds 260 records and an ascending query limits away the newest weeks.
issues.resolution: Limit newest-first in storage, then restore chronological chart order.

issues.trigger: A quote provider returns NaN, infinite, nonpositive or contradictory OHLC prices.
issues.resolution: Reject invalid prices before they reach the quote cache or JSON API; preserve the existing optional-quote recovery path.

issues.trigger: An upstream persistence service returns HTTP 200 with invalid JSON or a non-row payload.
issues.resolution: Check all read and search-RPC payloads at the repository boundary and return safe retryable 503 JSON without exposing the upstream body.
